name: Brutal critical hits
author: Alexandria
summary: A critical hit deals the dice's maximum plus a normal roll, so crits always feel big.

rules.text: On a **critical hit**, the damage dice that would be doubled are instead **maximum + one roll**: take the highest each die can show, then roll them once more and add it. Modifiers are added once.

assistant.gm: Brutal crits are on: on a critical hit, the doubled dice deal their maximum plus one normal roll (e.g. 2d6 on a crit is 12 + 2d6), modifiers once. Apply it to monsters too unless the GM says otherwise.
assistant.player: At this table a critical hit deals the dice's maximum plus a normal roll (2d6 becomes 12 + 2d6), with modifiers added once.
